sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: RELATIVELY FAST MID-LEVEL FLOW OF MODEST AMPLITUDE WILL RESIDE OVER THE CONUS TODAY. A MID/UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE WILL BUILD OVER THE GREAT PLAINS AND BE FLANKED TO THE WEST AND EAST BY BROAD TROUGHING AND CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT. THE STRONGER OF THE TWO PROGRESSIVE TROUGHS WAS ALREADY PRODUCING 60-90M 12H 500MB HEIGHT FALLS ACROSS THE INTERIOR NORTHWEST THIS MORNING AND WILL INDUCE LEE-SIDE CYCLOGENESIS ACROSS MT/WY LATER TODAY. IN THE SOUTHEAST...A LOW AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX WILL ACT TO MAINTAIN ASCENT ALONG A WEAK RESIDUAL FRONTAL SEGMENT SETTLING SEWD ACROSS AL/GA/SC.

sections.title: ERN MT AND ADJACENT AREAS OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: BREAKDOWN OF THE UPPER RIDGE ACROSS THESE AREAS AND THE SUBSEQUENT DEEPENING OF A LEE-SIDE SFC LOW WILL SET THE STAGE FOR MORE VIGOROUS TSTM DEVELOPMENT LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. STEEPENING LAPSE RATES AND DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN...COMBINED WITH STRENGTHENING LARGE SCALE ASCENT...WILL CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASING CONVECTION BY 18Z. INITIAL ACTIVITY WILL DEVELOP AMIDST MEAGER INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE WELL BELOW 500 J/KG. WITH TIME AND EWD EXTENT...SURFACE HEATING AND NOMINALLY RICHER DEEP-LAYER MOISTURE SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO MODEST DESTABILIZATION WITH HIGH-BASED STORMS SPREADING INTO AN AXIS OF MLCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1000-1500 J/KG FROM SERN MT/NERN WY AND ADJACENT AREAS OF ND/SD AND NEB. WEAK ELY BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW TOPPED BY 40-50KT SWLY FLOW AT 5-6KM AGL WILL PROVIDE MORE THAN ADEQUATE VERTICAL SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS/SUPERCELLS. IN ADDITION TO HAIL POTENTIAL...DRY SUB-CLOUD LAYER AND LARGE SFC TEMP/DEWPOINT DEPRESSIONS..AND RELATIVELY FAST STORM MOTION...SHOULD ALL SUPPORT INCREASING CHANCES FOR DAMAGING TSTM WINDS INTO THE EVENING. ONE OR TWO TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT. DESPITE GENERALLY HIGH CLOUD BASES...AFWA AND SPC SSEO GUIDANCE INDICATE VERY

sections.title: SOUTHEAST
sections.text: A FEW TSTMS MAY POSE AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL FROM ERN AL ACROSS CNTRL GA AND INTO WRN SC THIS AFTERNOON AS BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES AHEAD OF A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH. A LINE OR TWO OF STORMS MAY FOCUS ALONG THE WEAK FRONTAL SEGMENT...PERHAPS ENHANCED ON THE MESOSCALE BY DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ACROSS CONVECTIVE CLOUD SHIELD. ..CARBIN/BOTHWELL.. 05/18/2014

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: THE ONGOING FORECAST IS ON TRACK...WITH ONLY MINOR ADJUSTMENTS BASED ON OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS AND 12Z MODEL GUIDANCE. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY OVER EASTERN ORE WILL TRACK EASTWARD WITH LARGE SCALE FORCING OVERSPREADING MT THIS AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MID AFTERNOON OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING ACROSS CENTRAL MT. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW STEEP LOW/MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES. LOW LEVEL MOISTURE IS LIMITED...BUT MLCAPE VALUES ARE STILL EXPECTED TO APPROACH 1500 J/KG. SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE THE MAIN THREAT...BUT AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY DEVELOP SOUTHWARD ALONG THE LEE TROUGH INTO EASTERN WY LATE THIS AFTERNOON...AND EVENTUALLY EASTWARD INTO THE WESTERN DAKOTAS THIS EVENING.

sections.title: GA/SC
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKING ACROSS WEST TN AND MS. THIS SYSTEM WILL MOVE EASTWARD ALONG A SURFACE QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY EXTENDING INTO GA/SC. STRONG HEATING ON THE SOUTH SIDE OF THE BOUNDARY WILL HELP TO DESTABILIZE THE AIR MASS AND YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 500-1000 J/KG. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG/SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY LATER TODAY AND TRACK ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. STRONG MID LEVEL WINDS AND STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY RESULT IN LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS IN THE STRONGER CELLS. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 05/18/2014

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: ESSENTIALLY NO CHANGES NEEDED TO REGIONAL SEVERE RISK/EXPECTED SCENARIO BASED ON LATEST OBSERVATIONAL/SHORT-TERM GUIDANCE TRENDS. REFERENCE EARLIER MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 615 FOR SHORT-TERM DETAILS. INITIAL STRONG/SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS STILL EXPECTED ACROSS AREAS SUCH AS SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST MT AND EASTERN WY...AND INTO THE EVENING HOURS ACROSS THE WESTERN DAKOTAS.

sections.title: GA/SC
sections.text: FORECAST REASONING REMAINS LARGELY UNCHANGED...BUT SPATIAL /MAINLY SLIGHT SOUTHWARD/ ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE TO THE SLIGHT RISK IN ACCORDANCE WITH LATEST OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS/BOUNDARY POSITIONING.

sections.title: SOUTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A LIMITED OR NON-ZERO POTENTIAL FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING A CONDITIONAL STRONG TSTM RISK...COULD CONCEIVABLY EXIST AS FAR SOUTH AS THE OK/TX PANHANDLES IN VICINITY OF THE DRYLINE LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. IF/WHERE STORMS DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON...HIGH-BASED STORMS WOULD BE CAPABLE OF DOWNBURSTS/SOME HAIL. ..GUYER.. 05/18/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1127 AM CDT SUN MAY 18 2014/

THIS ACTIVITY WILL SPREAD EASTWARD INTO THE WESTERN DAKOTAS TONIGHT. MARGINALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL ARE ALSO POSSIBLE OVER SOUTH-CENTRAL AND SOUTHEASTERN GEORGIA.

sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST WITH SOUTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW IN PLACE ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN ROCKIES. AT THE SFC...A 996 MB LOW IS LOCATED ACROSS NERN WY WITH AN AXIS OF INSTABILITY EXTENDING FROM WRN NEB NNWWD INTO SW SD...NW WY AND SERN MT. SEVERAL SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING NEAR THE INSTABILITY AXIS WITH A LINE OF STORMS ORGANIZING ALONG THE NRN END OF THE CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY EAST OF BILLINGS MT. CONVECTION ASSOCIATED WITH THIS LINE SHOULD CONTINUE TO EXPAND IN COVERAGE...WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF MCS DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD MOVE INTO THE WESTERN DAKOTAS THIS EVENING. MESOANALYSIS FROM THE RAP-V2 SUGGESTS MLCAPE VALUES ARE IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE FROM SE MT SEWD INTO WRN SD. THIS COMBINED WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR AROUND 50 KT EVIDENCED ON THE RAPID CITY SD WSR-88D VWP SHOULD BE FAVORABLE SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED SHORT LINE-SEGMENTS THIS EVENING. SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A BRIEF LANDSPOUT MAY OCCUR ACROSS WRN SD AND WRN NEB WHERE CELLS SHOULD REMAIN DISCRETE. FURTHER NORTHWEST IN SERN MT...LINEAR MODE SHOULD BE DOMINANT WHICH WILL RESULT IN A WIND DAMAGE THREAT. THIS TH

sections.title: SCNTRL GA
sections.text: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A LOW PRESSURE TROUGH ACROSS SRN AL EXTENDING ESEWD ACROSS FAR SRN GA. TO THE NORTH OF THIS FEATURE...A WEST-TO-EAST AXIS OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS PRESENT WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F ACROSS SCNTRL GA. THIS IS RESULTING IN A POCKET OF INSTABILITY WHERE A SMALL CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. THE LATEST REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 40 TO 45 KT. THIS COMBINED WITH UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES ABOVE 1 KM MAY BE ENOUGH FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS. ..BROYLES.. 05/19/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM ECNTRL AL THROUGH CNTRL GA BY 19-20Z AND SPREAD SEWD. SOME OF THE STRONGER STORMS WILL POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS AFTERNOON A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS FROM SRN SC WWD INTO CNTRL GA JUST SOUTH OF ATLANTA...THEN FARTHER WEST THROUGH WCNTRL AL NEAR TUSCALOOSA. THE FRONT IS BEING REINFORCED BY DIFFERENTIAL HEATING WITH WIDESPREAD CLOUDS NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY AND CLEAR SKIES SOUTH WHERE MLCAPE IS EXPECTED TO PEAK AROUND 1000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. WV IMAGERY INDICATES A SHORTWAVE TROUGH DROPPING SEWD THROUGH THE TN VALLEY WITH DEEPER FORCING FOR ASCENT EVIDENT ACROSS NRN AL SPREADING SEWD. INITIATION OF THUNDERSTORMS APPEARS LIKELY AS TEMPERATURES APPROACH 80. VISIBLE IMAGERY ALREADY SHOWS CUMULUS INCREASING IN VICINITY AND JUST SOUTH OF THE FRONT ACROSS ECNTRL AL INTO WCNTRL GA. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS WEAK...BUT MODERATE UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY WINDS ALOFT ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF A LARGE SCALE TROUGH WITH 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT BOTH MULTICELLS AND STORMS WITH MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN FROM SW INTO CENTRAL MT. SOME OF THESE STORMS MAY PRODUCE GUSTY WINDS AND SMALL HAIL. FURTHER EAST INTO SE MT...NE WY AND THE WRN DAKOTAS...SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL BEING THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO IS POSSIBLE. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN FROM SW INTO CENTRAL MT EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. LACK OF STRONGER INSTABILITY AND LOW LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD LIMIT THE OVERALL INTENSITY OF THESE STORMS...BUT STEEP LAPSE RATES AND FAST STORM MOTION COULD YIELD A STRONGER WIND GUST IN ADDITION TO SOME SMALL HAIL. THE MAIN SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR FURTHER EAST ACROSS PARTS OF SE MT INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS AND NE WY LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. VIS SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED SOME CUMULUS DEVELOPING BOTH NEAR HIGHER TERRAIN AND OVER THE HIGH PLAINS. AS THE UPPER SHORTWAVE IMPULSE CURRENTLY OVER ERN ORE/WRN ID CONTINUES TO PIVOT E/NE...DEEP LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL INCREASE ACROSS THE REGION. FURTHERMORE...AN EWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT AND DEEPENING LEE SFC LOW WILL PROVIDE FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPMENT BY 20-21Z IN THE VICINITY OF LWT TO BIL. LOW LEVEL MOISTURE APPEARS TO BE PERHAPS A LITTLE BETTER THAN PREVIOUS MODEL INDICATIONS...WITH DEW POINTS CLIMBING INTO THE LOW 50S AT OF 18Z. WITH CONTINUED SFC HEATING...SBCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500 J/KG /PERHAPS POCKETS APPROACHING 2000 J PER KG/ ARE EXPECTED. STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR GREATER THAN 30 KTS WILL ALLOW FOR SOME ROTATING STRUCTURES AND/OR BOWING SEGMENTS. EVEN WITH BETTER THAN EXPECTED LOW LEVEL MOISTURE...TEMPERATURE-DEW POINT SPREADS WILL STILL BE ON THE ORDER OF 20-30 DEGREES F AND STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT. ADDITIONALLY...STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 7.5 DEG C/KM AND COLD TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL SUPPORT SOME INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL. A TORNADO OR TWO MAY BE POSSIBLE TOWARD EVENING WHEN AN INCREASING LOW LEVEL JET WILL MAXIMIZE LOW LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES AND LCL HEIGHTS BEGIN TO LOWER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES FOR WW 158. ADDITIONALLY...A NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST AND SOUTHEAST DUE TO NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER EASTERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AND JUST EAST OF THE WW AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF SVR TSTMS WAS LOCATED NEAR BILLINGS AT 2255Z...WITH ADDITIONAL TSTMS DEVELOPING EAST OF THE BIG HORN MTNS IN NERN WY. THE ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR SVR TSTMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS OWING TO 500 TO 1500 J/KG MLCAPE AND EFFECTIVE SHEARS OF 55 TO 60 KTS. LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO REMAIN POSSIBLE. AN APPROACHING UPPER LEVEL IMPULSE WILL PROVIDE ADDITIONAL FORCING FOR ASCENT OVER THE DISCUSSION AREA THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET WILL ENLARGE HODOGRAPHS AND LOWER LCLS MAY LEAD TO A BRIEFLY INCREASED TORNADO THREAT. WITH TIME COLD POOL GENERATION WILL LIKELY LEAD TO ONE OR MORE LINES OF STORMS WITH A MORE CONCENTRATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS CENTRAL GEORGIA. THESE THUNDERSTORMS MAY BRIEFLY APPROACH SEVERE LIMITS /HAIL TO 1 INCH AND WINDS TO 60 MPH/ BEFORE WEAKENING WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED SOUTH OF AN EXTENSIVE CLOUD SHIELD WHERE WARM SURFACE TEMPERATURES...MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...AND COLD AIR ALOFT HAVE RESULTED IN MUCAPE VALUES BETWEEN 1000-1500 J/KG. GIVEN DEEP LAYER SHEAR VALUES BETWEEN 40-50 KTS...UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION/ROTATION MAY BRIEFLY SUPPORT HAIL AROUND 1 INCH AND STRONG/GUSTY WINDS NEARING 60 MPH. AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES COOL WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN AS THEY MOVE EAST. GIVEN THE LIMITED SPATIO-TEMPORAL THREAT...A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER WW 159 AND VALID PORTIONS OF WW 158.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SVR TSTMS CONTINUE ACROSS SERN MT AT 0130Z WHILE TSTMS ELSEWHERE ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA HAVE GENLY WEAKENED SINCE 01Z. LATEST MESOANALYSIS DEPICTS A SURFACE LOW OVER NERN WY WITH A MODESTLY MOIST SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS SERN MT/NERN WY/WRN DAKS. THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING WILL CONTINUE TO RESULT IN GRADUALLY INCREASING CINH WITH TIME...THOUGH THIS MAY BE OFFSET SOMEWHAT BY ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE EMBEDDED WITHIN THE SWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW MOVING ACROSS THE AREA. TSTM COMPLEX OVER ROSEBUD/POWDER RIVER COUNTIES IS MOVING THROUGH AN INSTABILITY AXIS CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE AVERAGING 750 J/KG AND GENERALLY ALONG THE NRN FRINGE OF STEEPER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. WITH A PRONOUNCED COLD POOL ESTABLISHED...THIS COMPLEX SHOULD CONTINUE MOVING EWD FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE MORE HOURS WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. THE LATEST HIGH-RES RAPID REFRESH GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO SUPPORT THIS TREND. ELSEWHERE...THE THREAT FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED SVR TSTMS REMAINS...ESPECIALLY ACROSS SRN PORTIONS OF BOTH WW AREAS IN PROXIMITY TO GREATER INSTABILITY AND STRONGER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WW 158 CONTINUES TO DIMINISH AND AN ADDITIONAL WW WILL NOT BE NEEDED BEYOND 04Z. THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES IN REMAINING PORTIONS OF WW 159.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE STRONGEST TSTMS...OCNLY SVR...HAVE MOVED E OF WW 158 AS OF 0330Z. A COLD FRONT HAS MOVED EWD TO A POSITION FROM NEAR GGW SWD TO SHR...AND THIS FRONT WILL MOVE INTO WRN PORTIONS OF WW 159 THRU 06Z. DESPITE INCREASING CINH...THERE REMAINS SOME POTENTIAL FOR THE CARTER COUNTY MT STORM TO REMAIN STG OR SVR THRU 04Z-05Z AS IT MOVES INTO HARDING AND PERKINS COUNTIES. ELSEWHERE...THE SVR THREAT WILL GRADUALLY DIMINISH WITH TIME AS DIURNAL COOLING AND CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS REDUCE INSTABILITY.
